data.narrative:
Atmo is a Series A AI & Software company founded by Alex Levy and Johan Mathe that has raised $29.1M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables spanning both public (1) and private (8) companies, including Scale AI, Reflection AI, Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, and Field AI, with valuations ranging from $2.0B to $29.0B.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $29.1M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage advancement, yielding $58M. Peer-median analysis across the five selected comparables produces a median valuation of $5.6B, with a range of $2.0B to $29.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in frontier AI valuations at this stage.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $49M (low) to $6.4B (high), with a median of $2.8B. This wide band reflects a fundamental tension: stage-progression mechanics suggest ~$58M, while peer comparables—particularly Reflection AI at $25.0B and Scale AI at $29.0B—anchor substantially higher. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, technical differentiation relative to the peer set, and whether peer valuations reflect sustainable market pricing or froth. Stage, burn rate, and customer concentration warrant detailed diligence before narrowing this range.
